routes.description:
Returns every token the caller may see, **including revoked ones**, newest first. Reads are narrowed by the caller's site and environment scopes; see [RBAC & Scoping](rbac-and-scoping.md).

Use `limit` and `offset` to page through large fleets. The filtered total is reported alongside the page.

query_params.name: offset
query_params.doc: Rows to skip before the first result.

query_params.name: site
query_params.doc: Site code to filter on. Principals with multiple site scopes must name one.

routes.response_notes: Bare JSON array; the filtered total arrives in the `X-Total-Count` header.

routes.description: Creates a token bound to the given roles and optional scopes. Tokens are create-and-revoke: there is no edit.

fields.name: site_scope
fields.doc: Comma-separated site codes; empty means unrestricted.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Whether the token is active on creation.

routes.response_notes: Returns the token secret once; it is never shown again.
